answer.reason: The verses state what Eliphaz did: he came to mourn with Job and comfort him, and he was rebuked by the LORD and offered a burnt offering.

clauses.english: came with his two friends to mourn with Job and comfort him
clauses.quote: they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him

clauses.english: was told by the LORD that his wrath was kindled against him for not speaking rightly of him
clauses.quote: My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends

clauses.english: offered a burnt offering as the LORD commanded, and Job prayed for him
clauses.quote: did according as the LORD commanded them

doubts: His speeches in chapters 4, 15 and 22 are arguments with Job rather than events, so they are left out.
